associations.rationale: The formal type directly defines a connecting morphism from quotient homology to subcomplex homology, matching the requested construction of the connecting map.

The formal type identifies the concrete connecting map with a categorical connecting morphism; this comparison supports the construction but is not the requested representative-independence statement.
The formal type proves that the lifted differential class is unchanged when the displayed lift data agree, directly giving one required choice-independence result.
The formal type proves equality of lifted differential classes from equality of quotient cocycle classes, directly giving the other displayed well-definedness or choice-independence result.
